label: Equivalent states and the initial partition
section: Equivalent states and the initial partition
subgoals: Group states by their outputs on every single input
Treat each group as a block of the initial partition
Note that equivalent states must share a block

label: Refining until stable
subgoals: Key each state by its block and the blocks of its next states
Split blocks whose states have different keys
Stop when a pass splits nothing and count the blocks

label: Counting passes and building the minimal machine
section: Counting passes and building the minimal machine
subgoals: Count the refinement passes that split at least one block
Build one state per block with transitions to blocks
Switch to compatibility and covering when the machine is incompletely specified
